title: Customer Remeasures Following a Ridgeline Company Check
content:
# Customer Remeasures Following a Ridgeline Company Check

Window Replacement Contracts — measure scheduling rate note.

**Rule.** The remeasure fee for the most recent completed customer-requested remeasure is multiplied by a company-check share set by the calendar days from the latest completed company remeasure ordered by Ridgeline on the contract to the remeasure date: when that company remeasure took place on the remeasure date or no more than 3 days (the same-trip day count) before it, the share is 0.75 (the same-trip share); more than 3 but no more than 14 days (the recent-check day count) before it, 0.9 (the recent-check share); a contract with no completed company remeasure, or whose latest one took place after the remeasure date or further before it, takes a share of one.

The share multiplies the remeasure fee before the fee is rounded to the cent.

## Input – judgement – output

| Latest completed company remeasure on the contract | Share |
|---|---|
| Same day as the customer's remeasure, or 1 to 3 days before | 0.75 |
| 4 to 14 days before | 0.9 |
| More than 14 days before | 1 |
| After the customer's remeasure date | 1 |
| None recorded as completed | 1 |

Only the latest completed company remeasure is read; an earlier one does not set the share.

## Boundaries (hypothetical customer remeasure on 2034-03-20)

- Company remeasure on 2034-03-17: 3 days before, share 0.75; on 2034-03-16: 4 days before, share 0.9.
- Company remeasure on 2034-03-06: 14 days before, share 0.9; on 2034-03-05: 15 days before, share 1.
- Company remeasure on 2034-03-22: after the remeasure date, share 1.
